entries.text: Now then, Miss Penny—and each of you young\nbosses, as well.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_01

entries.text: On behalf of the academy, I have something I\nwould like to say to Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_02

entries.text: You all have...my sincerest apologies.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_03

entries.text: ...Come again?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_01

entries.text: As director of the academy, I let you down. My\nhandling of your situation was a dismal failure...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_04

entries.text: Wha—? I still don’t... I mean... Why?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_02

entries.text: You all told me about your reasons for forming\nTeam Star and about your subsequent actions.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_05

entries.text: Ever since my first days as director, all I’ve ever\nexperienced of the academy is an environment\r\nblessedly free from bullying.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_06

entries.text: But I now know this peace was built on the backs\nof your hurt and anger—and, of course, your\r\nimmense courage in putting things to right.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_07

entries.text: And so, I’ll get straight to the conclusion.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_08

entries.text: The academy’s order for Team Star to disband\nand my threat to expel those who did not obey...\r\nare hereby revoked![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_09

entries.text: Does that mean what I think it means...?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: team_0160_aku_03

entries.text: Indeed! Team Star can continue to exist, should\nthat be your wish![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_10

entries.text: Woo-hoo! Penny, isn’t this great? Now we can all\nstay together![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_03

entries.text: O, mine heart is giddy with glee![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: team_0160_doku_03

entries.text: B-but...I betrayed all of you...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_03

entries.text: You mean Operation Starfall? Director Clavell\ntold us all about it![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: team_0160_fairy_01

entries.text: Far as we heard, you only went through with it\nto save us from getting expelled!\c\nYou were just worried about us, right?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: team_0160_aku_01

entries.text: Not like we’d ever chuck the team just ’cause\nsomeone told us to, after all. Ain’t our style.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: team_0160_honoo_01

entries.text: I cannot even begin to imagine how you must\nhave fear’d for us, Lady Penny...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: team_0160_doku_01

entries.text: Sorry for making you worry, B.B. We’re all\nOK now.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_01

entries.text: But—! Even so...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_04

entries.text: Hold on, everyone. I’ve more to say.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_11

entries.text: As previously stated, the requirement for Team\nStar to disband has been revoked.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_12

entries.text: However! There are still some unsettled matters\nto discuss. Allow me to provide a few examples...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_13

entries.text: Your protracted truancy! Your brazen\ncustomization of school uniforms![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_14

entries.text: Your unauthorized usage of academy equipment![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_26

entries.text: Your reckless modification and jeopardous\ndriving of Pokémon-powered vehicles![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_27

entries.text: Need I go on? Your flagrant disregard for school\nrules cannot simply be overlooked![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_28

entries.text: Thus, as punishment, you will all be required to\nengage in community service.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_15

entries.text: Community...service?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_05

entries.text: Yes. Specifically, I will be asking you to manage\nthe STCs.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_16

entries.text: Aaand that stands for...?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_06

entries.text: The Star Training Centers![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_17

entries.text: They shall be facilities for cultivating Pokémon\nTrainers’ talents. I plan for the academy to found\r\nthem in collaboration with the Pokémon League.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_18

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The idea came to me when I saw M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
battling
h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser
way
through
your bases.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_19

entries.text: The bases’ construction, as well as the battle\ntactics employed by the students in Team Star,\r\nare remarkably unique and creative![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_20

entries.text: I would ask that you continue your team activities\nbut henceforth as STC staff members, using your\r\nformer bases as training facilities.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_21

entries.text: And that is the sum of it. Does anyone have\nany concerns?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_22

entries.text: Um...no? It sounds like fun, so I don’t see how\nthis’d be anything but a win-win...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_07

entries.text: This may be a weird thing to say since the STCs\nare supposed to be a punishment and all, but\r\nyou should totally join in too, Penny![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: team_0160_fairy_02

entries.text: ’Tis true... We would most happily have you at\nour sides, my lady.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: team_0160_doku_02

entries.text: We can go to school together too! That way if\nanything happens, we’ll be there to protect you![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_02

entries.text: We were already talkin’ about how great it’d be\nto have both Team Star and school in our lives.\r\nThis’d be a sweet deal for us![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: team_0160_aku_02

entries.text: So, whaddya say...?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: team_0160_honoo_02

entries.text: You guys...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_08

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...what do you think?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_09

entries.text: I think it sounds great!
entries.label: team_0160_select_01

entries.text: Give it your best!
entries.label: team_0160_select_02

entries.text: Huh? B-but—! Ummm... I just...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_10

entries.text: No need to give your response right this moment,\nMiss Penny. Do take some time to decide.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_23

entries.text:
For now, at least, I think our little group should
go their separate ways.\c
Ah. Not to say you should break up Team Star
after all! I simply meant it is time to leave.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_24
